scope: Read-only revenue diagnosis: Stripe Checkout, Search Console, GitHub, hosted aggregate counters and URL Inspection. No Checkout creation, payment, tool calls, emails or external writes.

stripe_28d.method: stripe checkout sessions list --live --limit 100; paginate until exhausted or oldest record predates window
limitations: Untagged does not establish a person.
Explicit probe=1 Sessions excluded from commercial totals; probe counts are measured, not hardcoded.

stripe_7d.method: stripe checkout sessions list --live --limit 100; paginate until exhausted or oldest record predates window
limitations: Untagged does not establish a person.
Explicit probe=1 Sessions excluded from commercial totals; probe counts are measured, not hardcoded.

stripe_completed.method: stripe get /v1/checkout/sessions --live -d status=complete -d limit=100 -d expand[]=data.line_items; exhaust cursor pagination and assert complete line-item coverage
limitations: Completed Checkout history and current known MCP price catalog, not all payment channels or net profit.
Metadata and line items independently cross-check host attribution. Older retired price IDs outside the current catalog remain a limit.
Two historical records are summarized without customer identity, session IDs or unrelated account amounts.
Platform-reported clients, not proven people, installs or successful jobs.
Rolling dataset can lag; daily unique clients are not additive.

search_console.method: Read-only service-account OAuth; GSC searchAnalytics/query, finalized page rows, contains-host prefilter then URL.hostname exact check; row cap checked
search_console.inspection_method: POST https://searchconsole.googleapis.com/v1/urlInspection/index:inspect with inspectionUrl and siteUrl; inspection only, no indexing request
limitations: 28-date finalized window ending three UTC dates before collection; GSC reporting dates are Pacific time. Not live current-day traffic.
Search Console excludes some data; page totals are not indexed-page counts.

funnel.interpretation: Recorded hosted response/event counts pooled across servers. ordinary means unmarked, not human or customer. Source labels are unverified declarations. First success is per anonymous token/server/UTC day, not lifetime use. No local usage or conversion rate is measured.
funnel.coverage: Starts only on deployment. Empty counters do not prove deployment, full-window coverage or zero historic use. Anonymous observations with missing/expired sidecars are unmeasured, except explicitly marked current probes.
funnel.limitations: Durable transactions preserve admitted batches and daily deduplication. Deferred write failures or unresolved cohort metadata drop observations. complete concerns bounded counter retrieval only, not full traffic capture. Sidecars expire 31 days after mint; their missing/negative-cached lookups never become ordinary.

upgrade_clicks.counting_rule: a click counts only when the request carries sec-fetch-mode: navigate AND sec-fetch-dest: document, its User-Agent names no crawler or HTTP library, it sends no x-mcp-probe header, it carries a Referer (any origin, real browsers always send one; scripts and the 2026-09-17 setup-page walker do not), and its ?src= is one a live page emits. Everything else is either not counted or bucketed under unattributed.*, which is excluded from total_clicks and clicks_7d.

legacy.note: instrument v1 (`click:` keys). Counted crawlers and this repo's own agents; never quote as demand. See docs/FUNNEL_R1.md.

privacy: Only aggregate counts and public URLs are persisted. Credentials, full Stripe objects, customer identifiers and session IDs stay in memory.
